description: Optional services fail visibly and independently: with no Gmail connection and no AI provider key, the Gmail send paths and AI dispatch answer a structured 503 {code:'provider_not_configured'} while every Release 0 money route still answers 2xx in the same app and environment. Run from apps/server: npx vitest run test/optional-services-fail-visibly.integration.test.ts src/modules/ai/model-gateway.service.spec.ts test/ai-direct-provider-503.integration.test.ts src/modules/ai/ai-usage.service.spec.ts src/modules/key-cortex/key-cortex-voice.service.spec.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-07-vitest.json against a migrated local database and REDIS_URL, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/optional-services-fail-visibly.json --report .proof/r0-07-vitest.json. allowAdditionalCases is true only because model-gateway.service.spec.ts and ai-usage.service.spec.ts also carry pre-existing suites (58 and 52 cases these packets do not own); requireReportSuccess keeps every one of them binding. Follow-up R0-07a-AI-DIRECT-503 (COST-LEDGER-001 section 7 item 1) adds the AI calls that bypass the gateway: with neither AI_INTEGRATIONS_OPENAI_API_KEY nor OPENAI_API_KEY set, AiUsageService.trackEmbedding/trackVision/trackAudio and KeyCortexVoiceService answer the same 503 {code:'provider_not_configured', service:'ai'} before any OpenAI client, provider call, rate-limit slot, credit check or AiUsageLog row, and KEY voice builds no client with the sentinel key 'sk-no-key'; with a key (SDK resources or transport stubbed) behaviour is unchanged. RED-BEFORE for R0-07a (claude/elegant-curie-7azpsb at ab8efa35): POST /crm/businesses/:b/import/scan answered 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (the SDK constructor's OpenAIError), POST /voice/businesses/:b/tts attempted new OpenAI with no key, KEY voice built its client with 'sk-no-key' and POST /api/v1/cortex/voice/speak and /voice/listen sent .../audio/speech and .../audio/transcriptions with Authorization: Bearer sk-no-key (7 of 10 integration cases failed); 5 of 11 new ai-usage cases and 5 of 10 voice cases failed. Four it.todo cases in the R0-07a suite record routes whose 503 body code is lost, or whose error is swallowed, outside its write set (KeyCortexController speak/listen, OpenAiVoiceProvider and KeyflowVoiceService, CommerceVisionService, SemanticMemoryService); they are not required cases. R0-07a review ST-1 adds one integration case (a member of another business only, naming this business in the query, is refused 403 on the KEY voice routes before KEY voice runs; it passes on the unmodified code and is a negative control, not a fix) and one it.todo (speak and listen read @Query('businessId') while BusinessGuard checks params, then body, then query, so a JSON body businessId splits them; the fix, @GuardedBusinessId(), is in key-cortex.controller.ts, outside this write set; COST-LEDGER-001 section 7 item 9), which is not a required case. RED-BEFORE on the R0 working branch before this packet: the eight Gmail 503 cases answer 400 BAD_REQUEST ('Gmail not connected' / 'Google OAuth not configured'), the AI chat case answers 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, and three of the four gateway cases fail (plain Error; no code on the stream error chunk). Review repairs: ST-1 adds three gateway cases (a circuit belongs to the credential that failed, so one business's revoked BYOK key cannot make AI provider_unavailable for another business, RED-BEFORE: the other business got 503 provider_unavailable and its platform key was never tried) and ST-2 adds one integration case (a signed Gmail OAuth state is accepted once, RED-BEFORE: a replayed state was accepted). Three it.todo cases in the integration suite record review findings whose fix is outside this write set (ST-2 user binding, ST-3 auth-url guard, ST-4/R07-CR-1 web GET 503 retry); they are not required cases.
